caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank in the shape of an organ grinder’s music box, labeled “ORGAN BANK” on its front panel. The bank appears to be primarily brown with gold and black decorative designs, latticed side panels, and ornate detailing at the base. On top of the bank is a figure of a monkey wearing a yellow, blue, and black cap, a red jacket, and yellow pants; this monkey is holding a round cymbal and is positioned next to two smaller animals that resemble dogs or possibly other monkeys, both of which are standing upright and facing forward. There is a crank handle on the left side of the bank. The image is drawn on a light beige or cream background, and the artist's name, "Beverly Chichester," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank
